**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

Section 9.4 (p0039) meets every preferred T4C element: Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form on thirty days' written notice, prompt refund of prepaid Fees allocable to the post-termination period, and an express denial of any Vendor convenience-termination right during a committed term. No early-termination fee exists anywhere in the document, and no other termination provision (§§ 9.1–9.3, 9.5, 10.1–10.2, 27.3) or the § 8.2 renewal mechanic gives Vendor a mid-term walk-away. The § 2.1 take-or-pay "without reduction or termination rights" tension belongs to the minimum-commitment rule and is noted rather than flagged here. No redline proposed.
